title: Simplify Night actions and activity
summary: Night and Changes now present one clear action per intent, with cleaner pending decisions and better-formatted activity history.
changes: Removes redundant Night actions so personal allocation, team allocation and Breaks each have one obvious route instead of repeated full-width shortcuts.
Collapses unresolved staffing and allocation prompts into one clear amber decision card while preserving separate confirmation actions when they are genuinely required.
Reformats Changes history and Night activity into compact structured rows with clearer hierarchy, metadata and state styling.
Strengthens the Review changes action and pending workflow styling without changing roster calculations, staffing rules or clock-change logic.
